build_MultiTaskHead: build a MultiTaskHead with sub-heads dict for multi-task learning in mmpretrain
create_loss_convertor: create a loss_convertor wrapper that masks inputs by task name for sparse batch labels
forward_MultiTaskHead: forward features through all task heads and return a dict of predictions per task
calculate_loss_MultiTaskHead: calculate losses for all task heads with task_name prefixed keys in the returned dict
predict_MultiTaskHead: predict on features and return a list of MultiTaskDataSample with predictions for each task
